name: Constipation
overview: Constipation is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include infrequent or difficult bowel movements. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: Health professionals note that constipation is a bowel dysfunction that makes bowel movements infrequent or hard to pass.
From a clinical perspective, the stool is often hard and dry.
In routine practice, other symptoms may include abdominal pain, bloating, and feeling as if one has not completely passed the bowel movement.
In routine practice, complications from constipation may include hemorrhoids, anal fissure or fecal impaction.
In routine practice, the normal frequency of bowel movements in adults is between three per day and three per week.
